title: Nuclear structure and nuclides
design_rationale: Build the evidence-based nuclear model before introducing nuclide bookkeeping.
concepts_taught: Infer a small, concentrated nucleus from alpha-particle scattering observations.
Describe the nuclear atom using protons, neutrons and orbital electrons.
Distinguish nucleon number from proton number and determine neutron number.
Interpret nuclide notation and identify isotopes.
Use the unified atomic mass unit as a mass unit.

next_module_can_assume: Infer a small, concentrated nucleus from alpha-particle scattering observations.
Describe the nuclear atom using protons, neutrons and orbital electrons.
Distinguish nucleon number from proton number and determine neutron number.
Interpret nuclide notation and identify isotopes.
Use the unified atomic mass unit as a mass unit.
next_module_must_not_assume: Radiation composition and nuclear decay equations are deferred.
